model: CenTraVac CTV-Duplex water-cooled centrifugal chiller (UC800 native Modbus)
applies_to: Trane Duplex CenTraVac (two-compressor) water-cooled centrifugal chillers with the Tracer UC800 controller, as listed in the Modbus section of BAS-PTS030A-EN (12/6/2024).
summary: Trane's Duplex CenTraVac is a two-circuit water-cooled centrifugal chiller. Its Tracer UC800 controller has a native Modbus map in which every point is one 16-bit register with a fixed SI scaling per register type (temperatures in 0.01 °C, pressures in 0.1 kPa, percent in 0.005 % steps). This map covers the BAS command registers and the input registers for water and refrigerant temperatures, pressures, starter and AFD values, bearing and winding temperatures and status enums.

addressing.note: The list prints Modicon register numbers: 4xxxx are holding registers and 3xxxx input registers, so 40001 is holding register address 0 and 30010 is input register address 9.

source.title: Symbio 800 Integration Points List, BACnet/Modbus, CTV-Duplex (UC800)
source.pages: p. 34 (Modbus object format), pp. 35-44 (holding and input register tables)

notes: The object-format table gives one fixed encoding per register type: Binary/Enumeration/Current/Voltage/Power/Concentration/Frequency/Flow/Pressure are unsigned 16-bit; Percent, Power Factor, Differential Pressure and Temperature are signed 16-bit. Scales: Temperature 0.01 °C, Pressure and Differential Pressure 0.1 kPa (printed as absolute for both), Percent 0.005 % (20,000 = 100 %), Power Factor 0.005, Frequency 0.1 Hz, Flow water L/min, Flow air L/s, Power kW, Current A, Voltage V.
Values are always SI in this native map; there is no I-P switch in the list.
Left out: all Time Interval points (purge timers, pumpout counters, refrigeration life, compressor running time). They are 32-bit (u32) over two registers and the list does not state the word order.
Left out: Compressor Starts Ckt1/Ckt2 (30086, 30142). Their type 'Count' is not defined in the object-format table and they span two registers.
Left out: Circuit Available Ckt1/Ckt2 (30217, 30218), printed with no register type.

Differential refrigerant pressure and oil differential pressure appear twice: 30058/30061 (Ckt1) and 30114/30117 (Ckt2) use the Pressure type, and 30187-30190 repeat them with the signed Differential Pressure type.
Last Diagnostic Code (30025) points to the diagnostic list in the BACnet part of the document; codes are not reproduced.
BAS-PTS029A-EN (CTV-Simplex UC800) carries a Modbus section that is essentially the same Duplex table (Software Type 458 = CTVD), so no separate Simplex map is made from it.
The points list does not name the Modbus transport (RTU or TCP); it refers to BAS-SVP083*-EN for protocol setup, so confirm the transport in the controller configuration.
30181 and 30182 are both printed as 'AFD Input Current L2 Ckt2'; the names are kept as printed.

integration.summary: Write 40001 (auto/stop), 40002 (mode) and 40003 (chilled-water setpoint, 0.01 °C) and poll the 3xxxx input registers with function 04. Every value is a single register; apply the per-type scale from the object-format table.
integration.enable: The points list does not describe setup; it names BAS-SVP083*-EN as its reference integration guide for enabling Modbus on the controller.
quirks: Percent registers count in 0.005 % steps (20,000 = 100 %), not 0.1 %.
Temperatures are signed hundredths of a degree Celsius; pressures are tenths of a kPa.
setup: Unit address, baud and TCP settings are set in the controller's protocol configuration; the list itself gives no defaults.
gotchas: Points not supported by the unit's configuration are absent or invalid; the list applies to Duplex (two-compressor) machines.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
